summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board approved a dividend on its 7.75% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock (NYSE: BW PRA). The declared amount is $0.4843750 per preferred share, with a record date of December 18, 2026 and a payment date of December 31, 2026. No advisor, premium, or transaction structure is involved. This is a routine preferred dividend declaration, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle is limited to ordinary preferred-carry and dividend-timing considerations.
